# A Place for Mom Referral Fees vs. Your Own SEO: The Real Math 

 A Place for Mom and Senior Advisor generate a lot of leads for home care agencies. They also extract a significant percentage of first-year revenue for every client they send. This post does the actual math on what referral fees cost compared to running your own local SEO program, so you can make an informed decision about how to allocate your marketing budget. 

Arikesavan

CEO, Home Care Growth · localseoguy.digital

10+ years in local SEO. Built ranking systems for 140+ home care agencies across 38 U.S. states.

#### In this guide

1. How referral platforms charge home care agencies
2. The real cost of one APFM referral
3. What the same money buys in local SEO
4. The compounding difference
5. Where referral platforms still make sense
6. The dependency risk
7. A practical transition plan
8. The actual math, side by side
9. Frequently asked questions

## How Referral Platforms Charge Home Care Agencies

A Place for Mom (APFM) and its sister brand Senior Advisor operate on a referral fee model. They do not charge you to list your agency or to appear in search results on their platform. Instead, they charge you when a family they connect you with becomes a paying client.
